records.name: Evil Eyes
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super. The user places a remote explosion at the opponent's location; when used in a combo, it can instead detonate along the opponent's flight path. Current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence notes slower activation with comparatively low endlag, and a damage profile suited to stationary targets outside combos. Piccolo (Power Awakening) can fire up to two additional blasts after the first.

records.name: Fake Blast
records.mechanics_notes: Ki Blast Evasive using 200 Stamina. The user fires a close-range Ki wave into the opponent's face, blinding them for 2 seconds; the move deals no damage. Current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence classifies it as an Evasive rather than a Super and lists training with Cooler (Final Form) as the acquisition endpoint.

records.name: Fake Death
records.mechanics_notes: 0-Ki Strike Super. The user falls backward into the Yamcha pose and can hold the input while lying down, then springs up with a kick. Current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence documents generous invulnerability frames during the initial animation and get-up, making the move a defensive counter option as well as a deceptive attack.

records.name: Feint Crash
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super. The user teleports behind the opponent and performs a restanding punch. An additional input instead teleports to the opposite side and delivers a kick that causes knockback. The regular version can be cancelled into many skills and stamina breaks; the alternate version is more limited and does not properly connect against already knocked-back targets.
